description: This file defines API routes for managing notes, including creating, listing, retrieving, updating, deleting, and searching notes for authenticated users. It uses FastAPI for routing and SQLAlchemy for database interactions.

methods.description: Lists all notes for the current user with pagination.

methods.description: Updates the title or content of an existing note.

methods.name: delete_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(db.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a note owned by the current user.

methods.name: search_notes(q: str = Query(..., description="Search query for title/content."), db: Session = Depends(db.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Performs a full-text search for notes based on a query string.
